messages.subject: changing default ggplot colours
parts:
Hi Listers,

I have plotted a scatterplot with a polynomial curve and 95% CI using ggplot. I want to change the final plot to a clear plot with all lines and text black although the points will stay grey. When I attempt to draw both sides of the x and y axis I lose my plot points and the regression line. I also cannot get the tick labels to change colour from grey to black. My code so far is below.

What I also want to do is convert the 95% CI from a shaded grey area to just dashed lines with no filled area


> p <- ggplot() + geom_point(data=soi.u_av.reduced, aes(x=soi,y=u_av),alpha=8/10,shape=21,fill="grey",colour="black", size=4)
> p <- p+geom_smooth(data=soi.u_av.reduced, aes(x=soi,y=u_av), method='lm',se=TRUE,fill=TRUE, formula=y~poly(x,2,raw=TRUE), colour='black')
> q <- p + theme(axis.line=element_line(colour="black"),panel.grid.major = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour="black"),panel.background = element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_line(colour="black"),axis.title.x=element_line(colour="black"),axis.title.y=element_line(colour="black")))

I cant see why my panel border call removes my plot and also why my axis.title calls arent changing the tick labels from grey to black?

Any help appreciated

Andy
